decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera is core to the firm's heritage, has its own web page, and carries sunk qualification costs, so dropping it would contradict the firm's public commitment and the direction it has announced.
Space situational awareness is a growing field the firm has publicly showcased, and any slow uptake can still be attributed to long agency procurement cycles.
The miniaturized LiDAR is less visible on the website, but it is central to the compact-sensor and docking strategy, and its costly space qualification argues for persisting.
The radiation-hard camera line was launched only in 2024 with its own page and several models, so investment and visibility are high and early results cannot yet be judged.
The asteroid navigation camera is tied to long-horizon mission work that is just starting, so weak early signals will be read as temporary rather than as failure.
